title: Vercel (team-scoped access token; the collector sends GET only)
readScopes: Team-scoped access token (Scope: the team, All Projects), created by a team member whose role can read team settings, members and project settings; Vercel tokens have no read-only setting

checks.title: Team sign-in is enforced through SAML single sign-on
checks.scope: Members of the Vercel team; the factors the identity provider asks for are not visible here.

checks.title: At most --vercel-max-owners members are team owners
checks.scope: Team-level roles; project-level roles are not counted.

checks.title: The team activity log is readable and not empty
checks.scope: Vercel's activity events for the team; retention and export are not judged.

checks.title: Deployment Protection covers preview deployments
checks.scope: Each project's Vercel Authentication or Password Protection scope; production custom domains may stay public by design.

checks.title: Pull requests from forks need a team member's authorization before they deploy
checks.scope: Projects connected to a Git repository.

checks.title: No credential is stored as a plain environment variable
checks.scope: Variable names and types only; a credential with an innocent name is not found.

checks.title: The Vercel Firewall is on for the project
checks.scope: Each project's firewall switch; the rules it runs are not judged.
